findings.summary: D1: T24 Step 1 requires recording whether a pull_request_review check attaches to the PR head before activation; the diff adds the activation timestamp without that verification record.

disposition.reason: Step 1 ran on 2026-11-11 and is recorded in #96 (https://github.com/magora-project/magora-portal/pull/96#issuecomment-6794452266): the pull_request_review run's check landed on the PR head

findings.summary: D2: T24 Step 2 requires recording acceptance-case run URLs and conclusions, including run_attempt > 1 for both retrigger cases; the diff activates review-gate without any of those records, leaving its required pre-activation safeguards unsubstantiated.

disposition.reason: Step 2 ran on 2026-11-11 and is recorded in #96 (https://github.com/magora-project/magora-portal/pull/96#issuecomment-6794452266), with run URLs, conclusions and run_attempt > 1 for both retrigger cases

findings.summary: D3: T24 Step 3 explicitly requires this activation PR to include .review/pr/<n>.json covering all three bot slots in every case; the full diff contains only the activation timestamp and omits that required record.

disposition.reason: The PR review record .review/pr/<n>.json is committed after the bot reviews are triaged; .review/ is excluded from the reviewer's input by design
